Very fulfilling combat and different combat scenarios. Defense is a great mode. Great open world. Upgrade system makes me want to get more upgrades. Plenty of different weapons.

I know a lot of people love Warframe, but the early quests are incredibly buggy.
I finally gave up after getting stuck on a quest I have to complete to progress — an enemy keeps spawning on top of a mushroom I can't reach. I can shoot it, but it just sits there safely sniping the objective I’m supposed to defend. All I can do is watch it slowly die.

Tried multiple times. It’s clearly RNG whether it happens, but I’ve never made it through the full defense without at least one enemy ending up on that spot. So, I can’t finish the quest, can’t move forward.

There’s no real challenge — enemies pop like wet paper bags — and yet I’m forced to repeat unskippable dialogue and broken sequences. It’s just poor design, and not worth the slog.

This ENTIRE GAME(except for community made cosmetics and portion of money $ goes to the creator) IS FREE. Even farming for the premium currency is easy to get via trading. DOZENS OF CLASSES and HUNDRED OF WEAPONS, all viable and obtainable, and can all be built differently. Insane customization in build min/max and most cosmetic customization than any game I've played. Higher level accounts don't mean stronger build, so it's easy to catch up. You can solo the game or multiplayer the game (multiplayer all share same rewards) and it's not pressure in multiplayer or expectations. 

Grinding the game can seem daunting (at the start only)  for items and the time on builds is long (which can be shortened with $), but once you're building a bunch, it's no bother. Also, being confused in the lore is on purpose and worth the confusion and grind as the lore progresses. The Lore reveals and building is worth the wait and play. Just play the game, what you enjoy, until it unfolds naturally.

The Digital Extremes developers and staff are known to be one of the most involved in the community of any video game. Listening to the community and interacting with them weekly. They listen to players, and they play their own game! Game developers that love and play their own game!

Lastly, THERE IS NO PAY TO WIN, as everything is obtainable for free. EVERYTHING.
